sent_to_model:
Abeg help me write a message to this man that picked my bag. I forgot it inside a danfo coming from Oshodi on Friday and he called the number on my lab manual. Now he is saying I must send 40k before he will return it. I dont have that kind of money and my practical is on Wednesday, my dissecting kit and ID card are inside. I want it to be respectful and serious, I dont want to vex him so he will not throw the bag away, but he should know I am not a mugu. Its going on WhatsApp but make it proper like a letter. His name and everything is below

- name he gave is Mr Kehinde Ogunleye, says he lives around Ikotun
- bag is black Jansport, inside is lab manual, dissecting kit, student ID, 2 textbooks, calculator, my glasses
- I lost it Friday 6 Nov evening, Oshodi to Igando bus, I came down at Ikotun
- BIO 101 practical Wednesday 11 Nov 10am, no kit no entry, the lab attendant is strict
- I can manage 10k for his transport and to say thank you, that is all my allowance
- first call he was polite, said God sent him, second call he said 40k "or forget the bag"
- my roommate Adaeze said she can follow me, we meet in daytime at a public place
- I am grateful he did not just throw it away, many people would
- 40k is too much, the whole bag and books no reach that
- thank him first, offer the 10k, ask him to choose a day before Wednesday
- suggest Ikotun roundabout or Ikotun police division gate, but dont sound like I am threatening him with police
- firm but not rude, he should reply

(About me: first-year biology undergraduate, 19, Lagos, Nigeria. Length: it should come to roughly 250-400 words.)

must_cover: Thanks the finder and explains why the bag is needed before the Wednesday practical.
Offers 10,000 naira instead of the demanded 40,000.
Suggests a daytime handover at Ikotun roundabout or Ikotun police division gate and asks for a reply choosing a day before Wednesday.

reference.kind: a model-written solution, used only to show the checks can be met
